{{Quote|Notable figues who had prospered under Palpatine, such as Wayulia Tagge-Simoni, were still active in galactic affairs and politics right up to the recent First Order-Resistance conflict.|Beaumont Kin, ''The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire''|<ref name="Rise" />}}
'''Wayulia Tagge-Simoni''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] [[baroness]]<ref name="TLJVD" /> who prospered under the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of [[Galactic Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]] as a notable figure in the [[Galactic Empire]]. Even after the Empire's fall, Tagge-Simoni remained active in galactic affairs and politics<ref name="Rise" /> and in [[34 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Film|VIII}} to [[34 ABY]].</ref> attended the [[Canto Casino and Racetrack|Canto Casino]] in the [[city]] of [[Canto Bight]] on the [[planet]] [[Cantonica]].<ref name="Rise" />

As she was too aged and decrepit to travel to the [[casino]] in person, she instead was present through a [[Hologram|holographic]] depiction of a much younger woman's head projected atop a [[droid]] body with fair skin and wearing a [[Color|black]] [[Clothing|gown]] and silver [[necklace]].<ref name="TLJVD" /> While in the casino she walked past the [[Resistance]] operative [[Finn]], who was there with fellow operative [[Rose Tico]] in search of the [[Master Codebreaker]].<ref name="TLJ">{{Film|VIII}}</ref> Following the [[Battle of Exegol]] in [[35 ABY]], the [[historian]] [[Beaumont Kin]] mentioned Tagge-Simoni in his [[book]] ''[[The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire]]''.<ref name="Rise" />

==Behind the scenes==
Wayulia Tagge-Simoni first appeared in the film [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']],<ref name="TLJ" /> which was released on [[December 15]], [[2017]].<ref name="Release Date">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-episode-viii-to-open-december-15-2017|text=''Star Wars: Episode VIII'' to Open December 15, 2017}}</ref> The character was not named in the film,<ref name="TLJ" /> but received identification in ''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: The Visual Dictionary]]'', a reference book written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]]<ref name="TLJVD" /> and released in conjunction with the film.<ref name="Release date">{{SW|url=news/new-star-wars-the-last-jedi-books-and-more-revealed-at-sdcc-2017|text=New ''Star Wars: The Last Jedi'' Books and More Revealed at SDCC 2017}}</ref> Wayulia Tagge-Simoni shares part of her double-barrel surname<ref name="TLJVD" /> with the wealthy and powerful [[House of Tagge]] of [[Cassio Tagge]]; however, whether she is a member of the family has not yet been established.<ref name="Force Collection">{{ForceCollection|General Tagge}}</ref>
